name: Achillesaurus
sum: Alvarezsaurid from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Río Negro, Argentina, named after diagnostic features of its ankle.
holotype: MACN-PV-RN 1116, a sacral and four tail vertebrae, part of the left femur, tibia, foot and left ilium, Paso Córdova, Río Negro, Argentina.
biology: Lived in the same formation as Alvarezsaurus; some authors regard the two as closely related.
author: Martinelli and Vera 2007

sources.text: A. G. Martinelli and E. I. Vera. 2007. Achillesaurus manzzonei, a new alvarezsaurid theropod (Dinosauria) from the Late Cretaceous Bajo de la Carpa Formation, Río Negro Province, Argentina. Zootaxa 1582:1-17
